title: Egyptian Spicy Broil Chicken
description: A spicy twist on traditional Egyptian chicken, grilled to perfection with a crispy broil.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together cayenne pepper and paprika.
Add the milk to the bowl and mix to create a marinade.
Add the chicken breasts to the marinade and coat evenly.
Let the chicken marinate for 30 minutes.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and grill for 5-6 minutes per side.
Broil the chicken for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
